# Preface {-}

This is the Embark Lab Meta Codebook. It documents the variables, measures, and value coding used across the POWERED, MAXED, MR21, and BAM studies, organized so that shared and study-specific measures can be looked up, compared, and filtered in one place.

Use the sidebar to navigate:

- **All Measures** — every variable from every study, organized by REDCap instrument, with filtering by project.
- **By Group** — the same variables regrouped into conceptual categories (Demographics, Mental Health Diagnosis, Eating Disorder Behaviors, etc.) with searchable/sortable tables.
- **References** — citations for the instruments used.
